rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Maintain the current claim/dependency/counterexample map from complete saved reports. Select the nearest unpaid lemma and perform a substantive derivation on that lemma each work cycle.

deliverables.description: LIVE_GAP_LEDGER.json: source-linked current claims, counterexamples, and unpaid leaves
NEXT_LEMMA_DERIVATION.tex: one substantive mathematical increment per work cycle

acceptance_criteria: Update the ledger only from complete saved result records, distinguishing proposed, analytically proved, finite certified, reviewed, and released states.
Select one nearest unpaid inequality and contribute a concrete derivation or exact failed step; a status-only acknowledgment does not complete the packet's mathematical cycle.
Keep retired/falsified versions discoverable so a renamed residual or obsolete constant does not reenter the active queue as new work.
assignments.renewal_milestone: Each renewed cycle changes one exact mathematical leaf or records a substantive failed derivation with a distinct next action.

assignments.target_statement: Try to transfer a proved lemma from one route into the exact missing term of another. Write the substitution with all hypotheses and constants; analogies alone do not count.

deliverables.description: CROSS_ROUTE_SUBSTITUTION.tex: explicit source lemma applied to an exact target term
TRANSFER_HYPOTHESIS_CHECK.json: every matched and unmatched assumption

acceptance_criteria: Write the substitution algebraically and verify variables, measures, normalizers, constants, and conditional laws.
Use a proved source lemma; replacing the target residual with another unproved universal endpoint is not a transfer.
Quantify the amount of the target debt now paid and state the exact remaining term or structural restriction.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One nontrivial bound transfers between routes with every hypothesis satisfied, or a precise incompatibility rules out the proposed transfer.

assignments.target_statement: At each campaign checkpoint compare mathematical output against predefined milestones. Reassign packets within available authorized capacity to distinct next lemmas; do not create extra workers or schedules.

deliverables.description: CHECKPOINT_ALLOCATION.json: active packet, pilot cycles used, outputs, and next assignment per stream
ALLOCATION_RATIONALE.md: mathematical evidence for keep/pivot/retire decisions

acceptance_criteria: Count only the twenty existing B-stream schedules and the hypothetical 100 A-packet design; A labels do not add 100 live workers or another twenty coordinators.
At each natural run choose one ready packet within the B-stream's five-item backlog, resume its exact gap, and record attempt/cycle use.
Renew a pilot only after its stated mathematical milestone or a justified new attack; when review queues are full, finish/review existing candidates rather than add more.
Never infer token prices, paid capacity, continuous runtime, or completed scheduled execution from this matrix.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A source-grounded checkpoint decision preserves authorized capacity and changes the next concrete mathematical task where warranted.

assignments.target_statement: Assemble the strongest fully supported proof into a single source with complete lemmas and references. Preserve open leaves as explicit conjectures until both independent audits close them.

deliverables.description: CANDIDATE_MANUSCRIPT.tex: complete statements, proofs, constants, and references
ASSEMBLY_STATUS.json: closed dependencies, explicit open leaves, and review evidence

acceptance_criteria: Assemble original complete derivations, not a chain of status summaries or undocumented cross-agent claims.
Keep unresolved leaves as conjectures/conditional hypotheses, with resulting theorem scope changed accordingly.

A full-FEI label requires both independent complete-chain reviews and closure of every all-dimensional, normalization, and limit obligation; a restricted theorem does not wait for full FEI to become useful.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One coherent candidate source accurately states exactly what has been proved and what remains open.

assignments.target_statement: Prepare the final accepted-theorem list, failed-route archive, proof status, and next ten precise research questions. Verify durable private artifacts and distinguish configured, executed, saved, reviewed, and publicly released work.

deliverables.description: FINAL_RESEARCH_LEDGER.md: accepted results, failed routes, proof status, and ten precise questions
ARTIFACT_RECEIPTS.json: actual saved versions, review records, and release receipts

acceptance_criteria: Every accepted theorem and failed route links to its complete source and the relevant independent evidence.
Distinguish configured, invoked, completed, saved, reviewed, and publicly released work; an assignment or upload is not a mathematical proof or execution receipt.
Keep the campaign report/research in the private destinations; any later public result uses the author's applicable dissemination authorization and an actual publication receipt.
Provide ten nonredundant continuation questions with precise hypotheses, target inequality, and first action.
assignments.renewal_milestone: At the final checkpoint the durable record is complete and honest; update only on new actual results or receipts.
